name: exe.dev
shortDescription: Cloud Linux VMs built for running coding agents — sandboxed, internet-addressable, with scoped GitHub access.
description: exe.dev provides Linux VMs on the internet, quickly — SSH and HTTPS in, proxied endpoints out — designed as sandboxes for agentic development. We run Claude Code sessions in exe.dev VMs with scoped GitHub access through its integration proxy, so agents work in a real environment with real tools while credentials and blast radius stay contained. This very page was authored from one.
useCases: Sandboxed VMs for long-running agentic coding sessions
Scoped GitHub access for agents via integration proxy, no raw credentials
Instant HTTPS endpoints for previewing work-in-progress services
